locationComparison.name: Dog spawns
notes: McGrubor's Wood holds the densest guard dog cluster (10 spawns).
Wild dogs (Brimhaven Dungeon) and jackals (Kharidian Desert) are alternatives; multi, cannon and safespot availability are not wiki-confirmed (conservative defaults).

taskNotes: Dogs requires combat level 15 to be assigned by Turael, Spria, or Mazchna. There is no Slayer level requirement.
slayerTargetId 286 is SYNTHETIC (c2-c3-worklist section 1 allocation contract); the real SLAYER_TARGET varp value is a QA live-verify item.
The Dogs task counts guard dogs, jackals and wild dogs; each is a distinct monster with its own page (no single Dogs monster page exists, so wikiPageId is null).
Guard dog: combat level 44, 49 HP, max hit 5 (crush), Defence 37, no bonuses, no elemental weakness (npc 114/7209).
Jackal: combat level 21, 27 HP, max hit 3, Defence 15, 10% fire weakness (npc 4185/11583).
Wild dog: combat level 63, 62 HP, max hit 6, Defence 54, no bonuses (npc 112/113); highest Slayer XP.
None of the dogs are undead, so the salve amulet does not apply. No task extension unlock exists for Dogs.
recommendedMethod: Kill guard dogs in McGrubor's Wood (10 spawns) with any melee weapon, since none of the dog variants have defensive bonuses. Wild dogs in Brimhaven Dungeon give more Slayer XP; jackals in the Kharidian Desert have a 10% fire weakness that fire spells exploit for a Magic alternative.
